agency_profiles_logo_ck.name: agency_profiles_logo_ck
agency_profiles_logo_ck.value: ("agency_profiles"."logo_storage_key" is null and "agency_profiles"."logo_content_type" is null and "agency_profiles"."logo_size_bytes" is null) or (starts_with("agency_profiles"."logo_storage_key", 'agency-logos/' || "agency_profiles"."agency_id"::text || '/') and "agency_profiles"."logo_content_type" in ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp') and "agency_profiles"."logo_size_bytes" > 0)

agency_profiles_colors_ck.name: agency_profiles_colors_ck
agency_profiles_colors_ck.value: ("agency_profiles"."primary_color" is null or "agency_profiles"."primary_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$') and ("agency_profiles"."accent_color" is null or "agency_profiles"."accent_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$')

agency_settings_commission_ck.name: agency_settings_commission_ck
agency_settings_commission_ck.value: ("agency_settings"."default_commission_type" = 'PCT' and "agency_settings"."default_commission_bp" between 1 and 10000 and "agency_settings"."default_commission_fixed_cents" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_currency" is null) or ("agency_settings"."default_commission_type" = 'FIXED' and "agency_settings"."default_commission_bp" is null and "agency_settings"."default_commission_fixed_cents" between 1 and 100000000000 and "agency_settings"."default_commission_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

agency_translations_length_ck.name: agency_translations_length_ck
agency_translations_length_ck.value: ("agency_translations"."tagline" is null or char_length("agency_translations"."tagline") <= 160) and ("agency_translations"."description" is null or char_length("agency_translations"."description") <= 5000)

contacts_merged_ck.name: contacts_merged_ck
contacts_merged_ck.value: "contacts"."merged_into_id" is null or "contacts"."deleted_at" is not null

developments_commission_ck.name: developments_commission_ck
developments_commission_ck.value:
("developments"."commission_bp" is null or "developments"."commission_bp" between 1 and 10000)
        and ("developments"."commission_fixed_cents" is null or "developments"."commission_fixed_cents" between 1 and 100000000000)
        and not ("developments"."commission_bp" is not null and "developments"."commission_fixed_cents" is not null)

developments_coordinates_ck.name: developments_coordinates_ck
developments_coordinates_ck.value:
("developments"."lat" is null) = ("developments"."lng" is null)
        and ("developments"."lat" is null or ("developments"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "developments"."lng" between -180 and 180))

units_specs_ck.name: units_specs_ck
units_specs_ck.value:
("units"."bedrooms" is null or "units"."bedrooms" between 0 and 1000)
        and ("units"."bathrooms" is null or "units"."bathrooms" between 0 and 1000)
        and ("units"."internal_m2" is null or "units"."internal_m2" >= 0)
        and ("units"."terrace_m2" is null or "units"."terrace_m2" >= 0)
        and ("units"."plot_m2" is null or "units"."plot_m2" >= 0)
        and ("units"."floor" is null or "units"."floor" between -10 and 300)

units_commission_ck.name: units_commission_ck
units_commission_ck.value:
("units"."commission_bp" is null or "units"."commission_bp" between 1 and 10000)
        and ("units"."commission_fixed_cents" is null or "units"."commission_fixed_cents" between 1 and 100000000000)
        and not ("units"."commission_bp" is not null and "units"."commission_fixed_cents" is not null)

agency_portal_connections_tag_ck.name: agency_portal_connections_tag_ck
agency_portal_connections_tag_ck.value:
("agency_portal_connections"."selection_mode" = 'TAGGED') = ("agency_portal_connections"."selection_tag" is not null)
        and ("agency_portal_connections"."selection_tag" is null or (char_length("agency_portal_connections"."selection_tag") between 1 and 40 and "agency_portal_connections"."selection_tag" = lower(btrim("agency_portal_connections"."selection_tag"))))

agency_invites_open_email_uq.name: agency_invites_open_email_uq
agency_invites_open_email_uq.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

feed_connections_pause_ck.name: feed_connections_pause_ck
feed_connections_pause_ck.value:
("feed_connections"."paused_at" is null) = ("feed_connections"."pause_reason" is null)
        and ("feed_connections"."pause_reason" is null or "feed_connections"."pause_reason" in ('VOLUME_SPIKE', 'MASS_WITHDRAWAL', 'EMPTY_FEED'))

media_objects_processed_ck.name: media_objects_processed_ck
media_objects_processed_ck.value: ("media_objects"."pipeline" is null and "media_objects"."variants_ready" = 0) or ("media_objects"."pipeline" > 0 and "media_objects"."variants_ready" >= 0 and "media_objects"."width" > 0 and "media_objects"."height" > 0)

property_media_video_ck.name: property_media_video_ck
property_media_video_ck.value: ("property_media"."kind" = 'VIDEO') = ("property_media"."sha256" is null) and ("property_media"."kind" = 'VIDEO') = ("property_media"."video_provider" is not null and "property_media"."video_id" is not null)

listing_overrides_text_ck.name: listing_overrides_text_ck
listing_overrides_text_ck.value: "listing_overrides"."title" is not null or "listing_overrides"."description" is not null

generated.as: case status when 'DRAFT' then 1 when 'ACTIVE' then 2 when 'UNDER_OFFER' then 3 when 'SOLD' then 4 when 'RENTED' then 5 when 'WITHDRAWN' then 6 end

properties_confirm_prompt_idx.name: properties_confirm_prompt_idx
properties_confirm_prompt_idx.where: "properties"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "properties"."deleted_at" is null and "properties"."confirm_prompted_at" is null

properties_network_hide_idx.name: properties_network_hide_idx
properties_network_hide_idx.where: "properties"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "properties"."deleted_at" is null and "properties"."network_hidden_at" is null

properties_agency_network_idx.name: properties_agency_network_idx
properties_agency_network_idx.where: "properties"."visibility" <> 'PRIVATE' and "properties"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "properties"."deleted_at" is null and "properties"."network_hidden_at" is null

properties_costs_ck.name: properties_costs_ck
properties_costs_ck.value:
("properties"."price_to_cents" is null or "properties"."price_to_cents" >= 0)
        and ("properties"."community_fee_month_cents" is null or "properties"."community_fee_month_cents" >= 0)
        and ("properties"."ibi_year_cents" is null or "properties"."ibi_year_cents" >= 0)
        and ("properties"."garbage_tax_year_cents" is null or "properties"."garbage_tax_year_cents" >= 0)

properties_commission_ck.name: properties_commission_ck
properties_commission_ck.value:
("properties"."commission_bp" is null or "properties"."commission_bp" between 1 and 10000)
        and ("properties"."commission_fixed_cents" is null or "properties"."commission_fixed_cents" between 1 and 100000000000)
        and not ("properties"."commission_bp" is not null and "properties"."commission_fixed_cents" is not null)

properties_specs_ck.name: properties_specs_ck
properties_specs_ck.value:
("properties"."bedrooms" is null or "properties"."bedrooms" between 0 and 1000)
        and ("properties"."bathrooms" is null or "properties"."bathrooms" between 0 and 1000)
        and ("properties"."year_built" is null or "properties"."year_built" between 1000 and 3000)
        and ("properties"."built_m2" is null or "properties"."built_m2" >= 0)
        and ("properties"."plot_m2" is null or "properties"."plot_m2" >= 0)
        and ("properties"."terrace_m2" is null or "properties"."terrace_m2" >= 0)

properties_coordinates_ck.name: properties_coordinates_ck
properties_coordinates_ck.value:
("properties"."lat" is null) = ("properties"."lng" is null)
        and ("properties"."lat" is null or ("properties"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "properties"."lng" between -180 and 180))

property_privates_import_hash_ck.name: property_privates_import_hash_ck
property_privates_import_hash_ck.value:
("property_privates"."import_hash" is null or "property_privates"."import_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and ("property_privates"."import_images_hash" is null or "property_privates"."import_images_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

property_privates_coordinates_ck.name: property_privates_coordinates_ck
property_privates_coordinates_ck.value:
("property_privates"."exact_lat" is null) = ("property_privates"."exact_lng" is null)
        and ("property_privates"."exact_lat" is null or ("property_privates"."exact_lat" between -90 and 90 and "property_privates"."exact_lng" between -180 and 180))

locations_depth_ck.name: locations_depth_ck
locations_depth_ck.value: "locations"."depth" = case "locations"."level" when 'COUNTRY' then 1 when 'REGION' then 2 when 'CITY' then 3 else 4 end

website_leads_target_ck.name: website_leads_target_ck
website_leads_target_ck.value:
("website_leads"."target_kind" is null and "website_leads"."target_id" is null and "website_leads"."shown_ref" is null and "website_leads"."owner_agency_id" is null)
        or ("website_leads"."target_kind" in ('LISTING', 'UNIT') and "website_leads"."target_id" is not null and "website_leads"."shown_ref" is not null)

website_leads_viewing_ck.name: website_leads_viewing_ck
website_leads_viewing_ck.value: "website_leads"."kind" <> 'VIEWING_REQUEST' or ("website_leads"."target_id" is not null and "website_leads"."viewing_slots" is not null)

website_leads_sizes_ck.name: website_leads_sizes_ck
website_leads_sizes_ck.value:
length("website_leads"."name") <= 120 and length("website_leads"."email") <= 254 and coalesce(length("website_leads"."phone"), 0) <= 32
        and coalesce(length("website_leads"."message"), 0) <= 4000 and coalesce(length("website_leads"."page_url"), 0) <= 2048
        and length("website_leads"."locale") <= 10 and coalesce(length("website_leads"."shown_ref"), 0) <= 64
